text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a research article (non-review) focused on identifying priority areas for biodiversity conservation (protected areas and OECMs) in China. While it uses land use data (cropland, pasture) as an input to exclude areas for food security and considers future cropland projections, the primary research objective is spatial conservation planning, not LULC prediction/simulation. It does not implement or produce spatially explicit LULC change projections for China under multiple scenarios, nor does it report quantitative accuracy metrics for an LULC prediction model. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for primary focus on LULC prediction and spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics.)
